Strategy: Spend what is already lost. Once a leftover is dead it cannot fit another same-size item, so its size no longer matters; using such a bin costs nothing extra, while usable bins stay saved. Score dead leftovers equally and usable ones by tightness, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to the oldest dead bin. Exact fits rank top. It may help by preserving usable bins, but may fail by wasting space that smaller items could still have used.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-item if 0 < r - item < item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Graded dead-band: all dead leftovers tie at -item, usable scored by tightness, exact fits top.
